# Creative Formats - Claude edition

Five creative skills in one folder. Two of them decide how your ad looks, three of them decide what it is.

## Setup

1. **Unzip** this folder.
2. **Open it in Claude Code** as its own project (`cd` into it and run `claude`).
3. Type the skill you want, for example `/claymation`. Or just describe what you want to make and Claude
   picks the skill on its own.

Nothing to install. The skills write the scripts, storyboards and prompts; you run them in the image, video,
voice and music tools you already use.

## What each one does

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/claymation` | The stop-motion clay look. Four sub-styles, each with a locked prompt block, plus the motion rules that keep the clay alive in video |
| `/paper-animation` | The paper look. Five sub-styles from layered papercraft to origami, plus paper transitions between scenes |
| `/song-style-ad` | A micro music video. An original song carries the story, the animated lead sings one or two beats on camera, the rest is silent B-roll |
| `/talking-object` | An animated character talks to camera. A person, an animal, a product, an ingredient or an organ, given a face and a voice |
| `/skeleton-ads` | The "what happens if you ___" progression ad, carried by one recurring 3D cartoon skeleton from day 1 to day 365 |

Each skill hands you a style menu or a script first, then the prompts, one approval gate at a time.
